name: durable-wait-demo
description: No-LLM demo of the `wait` body kind (zero tokens). Phase 1 stamps a start marker, then a 5s durable timer parks the run (on the server it snapshot-pauses at zero cost and the wait sweeper resumes it), then a signal wait parks until `POST /api/runs/<id>/signal {"signal":"go","payload":"..."}` delivers — the payload becomes the phase output. The final phase folds both results. `timeoutSeconds` keeps the demo from parking forever if nobody signals.

code.source: return 'no go-signal arrived within an hour; continuing without it'
